headline.purpose: Section titles, each set on its own ink or teal film with a registration target.

title.purpose: The uppercase heading at the top of a project slip.

body-lede.purpose: The first sentence of a major slip, max 34ch.

body.purpose: All reading text on paper slips, 52 to 60ch. Emphasis by weight (600 to 720), not size.

label.purpose: Nav links, run-in caption labels, list headings, definition terms, table headers. Never a kicker above a title.

label-action.purpose: Every action and the LinkedIn tab, uppercase with an up-right arrow.

mono.purpose: Tokens, dates, file names and measurements only, with tabular and slashed-zero figures.

shadows.name: fixed-tab-lift
shadows.purpose: The fixed LinkedIn tab only, separating fixed chrome from the stack scrolling under it.

shadows.name: top-film-lift
shadows.purpose: The first screen's Dowse clip only. No other film or slip casts a shadow.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for every entrance, develop and hover.

motion.name: register
motion.value: 1.1s ease, from translate(var(--mx), var(--my)) with 8-16px offsets; stagger 0, 90, 170, 240ms
motion.purpose: First-screen entrance only: films and slips start out of register and slide into place once. Animates transform, never rotate or translate.

motion.name: develop-in
motion.value: 1.6s ease, 0.35s delay; --dot 1.1px to 7.2px on a 10px mask cell
motion.purpose: The first-screen clip develops out of a coarse halftone on load.

motion.name: develop-scroll
motion.value: transition --dot 1.3s ease; latent if top > 85% of first viewport; develops once at 82% of viewport
motion.purpose: Clips and images below the fold start latent and develop once as they arrive.

motion.name: parallax
motion.value: translate: 0 ((atTop ? -scrollY : center - mid) * depth * k)px; k = 1, or 0.45 at 760px and below; depth -0.14 to +0.08
motion.purpose: Each layer moves at its own depth. First-screen layers rest at zero; others pass through zero at mid-screen. Title and slip share a depth; screens deepest, clips nearest.

motion.name: spot-focus
motion.value: filter: grayscale(1) contrast(0.92); transition 0.7s ease; centre band rootMargin -40% 0px -40% 0px
motion.purpose: Only the section in focus carries full spot ink; the rest of the stack sits in grey.

motion.name: misregister-hover
motion.value: teal ::before, multiply, opacity 0 to 0.35, translate(0,0) to (4px, 3px); 0.25s transform, 0.2s opacity
motion.purpose: Action hover: a teal pass drifts out of register under the label.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: Link underline turns from teal to the text colour on hover.

motion.name: clip-toggle-fade
motion.purpose: The clip pause button appears on hover or focus.

motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: The predicted-token caret blinks four times and stops.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes the entrance, load develop and caret blink; never sets images latent; skips parallax; clips wait for Play; the action hover pass appears instantly. The section-focus colour change remains.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column stack, screens hidden, nav wraps, slips inset over their media.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Crop marks hidden, pipeline one column, benchmark table becomes stacked rows.

narrative.overview:
The site is a stack of printed film positives laid on a pale light table and registered to one grid, in the manner of 1970s Basel layered-film typography. Each piece of content is a separate sheet: a black ink film, a translucent teal film, a yellow or grey halftone screen, or a clean paper slip. Sheets overlap, sit a degree or so off square, and slide apart at different depths as the page scrolls. Crop marks frame the slips and a printer's registration target pins each section title, so the montage always reads as made on purpose rather than scattered.

The palette is two spot inks over neutral film. Teal is Walid's ink: his surname, half the section titles, every link underline and the focus ring (deep teal on light surfaces, full teal on ink). Tram yellow is the second ink, kept for what Dowse finds and for the next thing to do: the LinkedIn tab, primary actions, the predicted token, the winning number, the top search hit. Black halftone ink carries the rest. Only the section in the middle of the viewport prints in full colour; the rest of the stack drops to grey, so colour follows attention down the page.

Type is one variable grotesk, Archivo, whose width axis carries the whole hierarchy: compressed to 62% for the name, widening step by step to 100% for reading. JetBrains Mono appears only for tokens, dates, file names and measurements. The density is low and editorial: big plates of type, short slips of copy, generous section gaps. This world replaces the earlier dark, neon-green monospace "terminal" portfolio and is light only.
keyCharacteristics: A light-table film base, never white and never dark.
Two spot inks (teal, yellow) plus black; colour lives on films, screens and edges, reading text lives on paper.
One family, many widths: Archivo from 62% to 100% stretch, uppercase for everything that is not a sentence.
Films and slips are hand-laid: tilted 0.3° to 1.6° and overlapping their neighbours.
Depth from overprint (multiply), overlap and parallax, not from shadows.
Square corners everywhere; crop marks and registration targets as the only ornament.
One authored entrance (films pulling into register) and one recurring effect (images developing out of a halftone screen).

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Teal and yellow are the only chromatic colours. Teal means Walid; yellow means the result or the next step. Do not add a third hue, and do not swap their meanings.

rules.name: The Spot In Focus Rule
rules.body: Only the section whose middle crosses the centre band of the viewport prints in full spot ink. Every film, screen, clip and image marked as spot ink elsewhere drops to `grayscale(1) contrast(0.92)` over 0.7s. Paper slips, text and actions stay in colour, and the fixed LinkedIn tab sits outside the stack and never greys.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Focus Rule
rules.body: The focus ring takes the teal that holds contrast against what lies under it: Deep Teal Ink on paper and the film base, Walid Teal inside ink films and screen recordings.

rules.name: The Paper Carries Prose Rule
rules.body: Paragraphs sit on paper slips. Films carry display words, numerals, mono strings and at most a one- or two-sentence caption. Body text never sits directly on a halftone screen.

rules.name: The Width Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by width before size: 62% display, 68% headline, 75% title, 82% label and action, 100% reading. A new role takes a rung on this ladder; it does not introduce a second family.

rules.name: The Mono Measures Rule
rules.body: Mono is for things a machine would print: tokens, dates, numbers with units, file names. Never for headings, sentences or buttons.

rules.name: The Capitals Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to display, headline, title, label and action roles. Sentences, captions and link text stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The One Register Rule
rules.body: Everything snaps to the 12-column sheet. Overlap and rotation are applied after placement; nothing is positioned absolutely against the viewport except the LinkedIn tab and the skip link.

rules.name: The Unequal Pieces Rule
rules.body: Work is never a row of same-size cards. Each piece pairs one film with one slip at its own spans and offsets.

rules.name: The No Drop Shadow Rule
rules.body: Films and slips sit flat on the table. The two lifts above are the whole shadow vocabulary; a new surface earns depth by overprint, overlap or parallax.

rules.name: The Shared Depth Rule
rules.body: If two layers must stay aligned (a title and its slip), give them one depth factor. If they should slide apart, give them opposite signs.

dos: Do lay every page on the Light-Table Film Base (#e4e7e1) and put all running text on Clean Slip Paper (#f7f7f5).
Do keep to two spot inks: Walid Teal for identity and links; Tram Yellow for the found result and the one next action.
Do set teal as text only in Deep Teal Ink (#08695f), draw the focus ring in Deep Teal Ink on light surfaces and in Walid Teal on ink, and set yellow as text only on ink films.
Do carry hierarchy on Archivo's width axis: 62% display, 68% headline, 75% title, 82% label and action, 100% body.
Do tilt films and slips between 0.3° and 1.6°, alternating direction with the neighbour, never past 1.6°, and overlap media and slip by 10–48px.
Do put a registration target on the top-right corner of every section title film and crop marks outside the corners of every main slip.
Do give a title film and its slip the same parallax depth, keep first-screen layers resting at zero, and put halftone screens on the deepest layer.
Do write parallax to `translate`, the entrance to `transform` and the hand-laid tilt to `rotate`, so the three never fight.
Do print every screen recording through the Clip: halftone develop, plays only while visible, a pause button that the visitor's choice overrides.
